title: Flat finite-presentation model of a scalar-extended module
statement: Let $R,C,A,B$ be commutative rings, with $R$-algebra structures on $C,A,B$, and let $f:A\to B$ be an $R$-algebra map. Assume $A$ and $B$ are finitely presented over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let $M$ be a finitely presented $B$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module], restricted to $A$ along $f$. Set $X=C\otimes_R A$ and $Y=C\otimes_R B$. If $X\otimes_A M$ is flat over $X$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], there exist commutative rings $P,Q$, a $P$-algebra structure on $Q$, a $Q$-module $L$, and a ring map $P\to X$, such that $P$ is finitely presented over $\mathbf Z$, $Q$ is finitely presented over $P$, $L$ is finitely presented over $Q$, and $L$ restricted along $P\to Q$ is flat over $P$. There is a ring isomorphism $e:X\otimes_P Q\simeq Y$ whose restriction to $X$ is the tensor extension of $f$, and, using the $Q$-action on $Y$ induced by $q\mapsto e(1\otimes q)$, a $Y$-linear isomorphism $Y\otimes_Q L\simeq Y\otimes_B M$. The $B$-action on $Y$ is its right tensor inclusion.

proof.text: Give B its A-algebra structure through f. Finite presentation over the finite-type algebra A and tensor base change make Y=C\otimes_R B finitely presented over X=C\otimes_R A. Tensor cancellation identifies Y\otimes_B M with X\otimes_A M as X-modules, so it is flat over X and finitely presented over Y.

source.place: Tag 02JO (1), applied to the scalar extension

proof.text: Apply the finite-presentation approximation theorem to X, Y and T=Y\otimes_B M. The approximation has base-change transition maps and the specified colimit identifications. Its base rings are finite type over the integers, its top rings are finite type over the base, and its modules are finite. The rings are Noetherian; the rings and modules therefore have the asserted finite presentations.

At each prime of Y contract the prime to every approximation ring and localize. Localization-colimit and localization-tensor identifications give the local ring systems and their module colimit. The limit module is flat over the localized base. Apply the local Noetherian eventual-flatness criterion to obtain a stage flat at this contracted prime.

At each stage the flat locus in the top spectrum is open. Localization commutes with base change and preserves flatness, so the inverse image of a flat locus is contained in each later flat locus. Their inverse images in Spec(Y) form a directed open cover. Quasi-compactness gives one stage whose flat locus pulls back to all of Spec(Y).

The closed complement at that stage is V(J). Its extended ideal in Y is the unit ideal. Lift the coefficients of a finite unit relation to one stage and its equality to 1 to a later stage. Every prime of the later top ring avoids one of these coefficients from J; persistence puts it in the flat locus. The prime-local criterion makes the whole model module L flat over its base P.

The approximation theorem gives the canonical isomorphism e:X\otimes_P Q\simeq Y and its compatibility with the map X\to Y. Its module base-change isomorphism is Y\otimes_Q L\simeq T. On pure tensors its Q-action is the right inclusion followed by e, exactly the algebra structure in the Lean statement.

theorem exists_flat_module_tensor_model
    {R C : Type v} {A B M : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing C] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [AddCommMonoid M]
    [Algebra R C] [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R A] [Algebra.FinitePresentation R B]
    [Module B M] [Module.FinitePresentation B M] (f : A →ₐ[R] B)
    (hflat : letI : Module A M := Module.compHom M f.toRingHom
      letI : Algebra A (C ⊗[R] A) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      Module.Flat (C ⊗[R] A) ((C ⊗[R] A) ⊗[A] M)) :
    ∃ (P Q L : Type (max v w)) (_ : CommRing P) (_ : CommRing Q)
      (_ : Algebra P Q) (_ : AddCommMonoid L) (_ : Module Q L)
      (_ : Algebra P (C ⊗[R] A)),
      Algebra.FinitePresentation ℤ P ∧ Algebra.FinitePresentation P Q ∧
      Module.FinitePresentation Q L ∧
      (letI : Module P L := Module.compHom L (algebraMap P Q); Module.Flat P L) ∧
      ∃ e : (C ⊗[R] A) ⊗[P] Q ≃+* C ⊗[R] B,
        e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom =
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Algebra.ofId C C) f).toRingHom ∧
        (letI : Algebra Q (C ⊗[R] B) :=
          (e.toRingHom.comp Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom).toAlgebra
         letI : Algebra B (C ⊗[R] B) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
         Nonempty ((C ⊗[R] B) ⊗[Q] L ≃ₗ[C ⊗[R] B] (C ⊗[R] B) ⊗[B] M))
